targets.text: Talk to my Pocket data: on-demand re-enrichment (pocketsync enrich), an MCP server (pocketsync mcp) and a private chat site (pocketsync web at recall.culture.dev) — one retrieval/enrich core, three surfaces with CLI↔MCP↔site parity
one shared core module serves all three surfaces: a grep shows no $vectorSearch or enrichment-selection query outside it

pocketsync mcp uses the official mcp SDK low-level Server over stdio behind a pocketsync[mcp] extra (mcp>=1.2,<2), lazily imported (ServerExtraMissing -> CliError exit 2 with an install hint), stdout reserved for protocol — mirroring culture-rules
importing pocketsync, pocketsync.cli and pocketsync.mcp leaves mcp out of sys.modules; pocketsync mcp without the extra exits 2 with an install hint and nothing on stdout

one verb registry drives CLI, MCP tools and site actions; a data-driven parity test asserts every registry verb exists as a CLI command and an MCP tool (and no extra tools), mutating verbs expose apply (default false) and dry-run otherwise
removing a verb from the registry, a CLI parser entry or an MCP tool each makes the parity test fail

pocketsync enrich selects recordings (--all/--since/--until/--id/--label/--status/--only) and re-queues them by flipping enrichment.status to pending with attempts=0 and clearing error/next_attempt_at, dry-run unless --apply; the existing EnrichmentWorker does the work (no second enrichment path)
dry-run writes nothing (collection snapshot unchanged) and lists exactly the selected ids; apply flips only selected non-deleted docs and only when content_hash still matches

--only classify re-runs the decider on stored chunk/summary text and writes only labels/filters/taxonomy_version, keeping vectors; --only embed re-embeds keeping labels — the worker gains a per-doc enrichment.mode (full|classify|embed) because _build_payload today does embed+classify all-or-nothing
--only classify leaves enrichment.chunks and summary_vector byte-identical and makes no embed call; --only embed leaves labels/filters identical and makes no classify call

gateway deferrals are persisted: when EnrichmentUnavailable defers a pending doc, the worker writes enrichment.deferred_reason and enrichment.next_attempt_at so status/doctor can say why the backlog is not draining and when it retries (today the reason lives only in the in-memory _retry map)
after a 503 the doc stays pending with enrichment.deferred_reason and next_attempt_at set; status --json reports them; a successful run clears both

a re-enrich that changes labels without changing content_hash emits one pocketsync.recording.reclassified event via the outbox (today Outbox dedupes on (id, content_hash) so reclassify publishes nothing)
exactly one reclassified event per label change; none when labels are unchanged; enriched events keep their (id, content_hash) dedupe

GatewayClient gains a chat-completions call (/chat/completions) with the model from a new non-secret setting POCKETSYNC_CHAT_MODEL defaulting to unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, so the chat lane can be switched (e.g. to Nemotron 3.5 Super VL) without code changes
changing POCKETSYNC_CHAT_MODEL changes the model field of the /chat/completions request with no code change; it is not a secret and not injected via grant
pocketsync enrich replaces the narrow reembed selector but reembed stays as an alias/compat verb (its JSON keys dry_run/model/dims/ids/count/updated are an existing contract)
pocketsync reembed output keys and behaviour are byte-compatible with 0.11.1 tests (tests/test_cli_status_reembed.py passes unchanged)

a read-only retrieval core (pocketsync/recall/ or similar) runs $vectorSearch over recordings_chunk_vec (root filters in parentFilter) and recordings_summary_vec (filters in filter), embeds the query via the gateway with prompt_name Query (embed() hardcodes Document today), excludes deleted_in_pocket and merged_into docs, and returns ids, titles, recording_at, score and the best-matching chunks with start/end offsets
search with a label filter puts it in parentFilter for the chunk index and filter for the summary index; deleted and merged docs never appear; query embed uses prompt_name Query

the vector index filter fields grow to include enrichment.filters.sensitive and enrichment.filters.has_action_items (today FILTER_PATHS is labels/deleted_in_pocket/recording_at only, so sensitive cannot be filtered inside $vectorSearch); vindex updates an existing index definition in place instead of only creating missing ones
an existing index lacking the new filter fields is updated in place (update_search_index) and stays queryable; check() no longer reports a mismatch afterwards

sensitive recordings are searchable by default on every read surface (user decision: internal network); an opt-in exclude_sensitive filter drops docs whose enrichment.filters.sensitive is at or above threshold; absent scores are treated as not sensitive
with default arguments a sensitive recording is returned; with exclude_sensitive=true no recording with sensitive >= threshold is returned and absent-score recordings still are

$vectorSearch is unit-tested through an injectable search seam (fake returns canned hits) since mongomock cannot run it; real behaviour (parentFilter on recording_at, deleted_in_pocket, sensitive) is covered in the opt-in tests/integration/test_atlas_local.py
the core takes a search callable; unit tests never need $vectorSearch from mongomock
read verbs get CLI parity with the MCP tools: pocketsync search, get, transcript, recordings (list), actions — all --json, all read-only, all runtime verbs under _grant re-exec
each read verb exists in CLI and MCP with the same parameters and returns the same JSON for the same inputs

pocketsync web is a stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer (like webhook/server.py) bound to loopback only on a new setting POCKETSYNC_WEB_PORT (default 8788), serving one self-contained HTML/JS page plus a JSON API (/api/chat, /api/search, /api/recordings, /api/recordings/<id>, /api/actions, /api/enrich) that calls the same retrieval/enrich core as CLI and MCP — no extra dependency and no second retrieval implementation
pocketsync web refuses non-loopback binds, adds no dependency, and its API handlers are the registry verbs

chat answers are generated by the configured chat model from retrieved chunks only, and every answer cites recordings with ids and start/end timestamps; clicking a citation opens that recording's transcript at the timestamp; a per-recording and per-result-set Re-enrich button calls the enrich operation (dry-run preview, then apply)
a chat response's citations each reference a retrieved recording id and an in-range timestamp; with no retrieval hits the answer says it found nothing instead of inventing

deploy adds deploy/systemd/pocketsync-web.service (grant run --inject, like pocketsync-serve) and a runbook section adding pocketchat.culture.dev as a second ingress hostname on the existing remote-managed pocketsync-culture-dev tunnel with a Cloudflare Access app allowing only the operator email and no Bypass; web verifies the Access JWT (team domain + audience settings) on every request
a request without a valid Access JWT (missing, bad signature, wrong aud, expired) gets 403 from pocketsync web even on loopback
after deploy: GET https://pocketchat.culture.dev unauthenticated -> 302 to Access; pocketsync.culture.dev routes unchanged (GET / 302, unsigned hook POST 401)

docs: CLAUDE.md, README.md and QWEN.md amend the 'no UI' non-goal to 'UI only as a thin client over the CLI/MCP surface'; all four harness files plus README, explain catalog, learn (text+JSON), overview._VERBS, tests/test_cli_surface.py NEW_VERBS and _grant.RUNTIME_VERBS list the new verbs
teken cli doctor --strict passes and tests/test_cli_surface.py covers every new verb

the sync contract is unchanged: file layout, landing schema, content_hash and the pocketsync.recording.enriched event stay as they are; new surfaces only read recordings and, for enrich, write enrichment.* fields through the sink's compare-and-set
existing sync/landing/event tests pass without edits
the webhook Bypass stays exactly pocketsync.culture.dev/hooks/pocket; pocketchat.culture.dev gets no Bypass; web and webhook servers refuse non-loopback binds
the Bypass app path is unchanged after deploy (Cloudflare read shows exactly pocketsync.culture.dev/hooks/pocket)
core stays dependency-free: mcp SDK only behind pocketsync[mcp]; web uses stdlib only; no numpy; the lobes gateway and other Mongo containers on spark are not modified
pyproject dependencies stay []; core import graph has no third-party modules

the operator (the one Pocket account owner) in a browser at pocketchat.culture.dev, and any agent harness (Claude Code, Qwen, colleague, the mesh) via pocketsync mcp, plus the operator's shell via the CLI
each named audience has a documented entry point (README: browser URL, .mcp.json snippet, CLI verbs)

recordings land in pocketsync-mongo enriched with vectors and labels, but nothing reads them back: no search, no chat, no MCP, and the only enrichment lever is reembed for model/dims mismatches (error docs and taxonomy or outage re-runs have no operator control)
0.11.1 has no read-back verb (pocketsync --help lists none) and reembed selects only model/dims mismatches

the operator asks 'what did we decide about X last week?' in the browser or any agent and gets a grounded answer citing recordings and timestamps, and can re-enrich any selection with one dry-run-then-apply action from CLI, MCP or a button
the after-state is demonstrated on synthetic data in tests and on live data by the c28 probes
the point of owning the data is using it: Pocket's own app chats only inside its cloud, while our copy can be searched by every agent we run, privately on our own gateway and network
no request from any surface leaves spark except via the Cloudflare tunnel to the Access-gated browser; generation and embedding go to localhost:8001

on the live deploy: pocketsync search returns the matching recording first for >= 3 of 3 operator-chosen probe questions; a chat answer cites >= 1 recording with a timestamp; pocketsync enrich --status error --apply drains to 0 retrying within one worker cycle when the gateway is up; recall.culture.dev returns 302 unauthenticated
the probes ran against the live deploy and their outputs (ids, counts, status codes only) are recorded on the PR
test suite: CLI↔MCP parity test passes for 100% of registry verbs, the full suite stays green and coverage stays >= 60%, teken cli doctor --strict passes, Sonar new issues = 0
CI on the PR shows all jobs green with the parity test included

re-queue is race-safe against an in-flight worker: enrich --apply bumps enrichment.generation and the worker's set_enrichment / set_enrichment_error CAS matches content_hash AND the generation it claimed, so a requeue issued mid-processing is not overwritten to done (today the CAS is on content_hash only, sinks/mongo.py set_enrichment)
a requeue issued while the worker holds the doc leaves it pending and it is re-enriched on the next cycle

web output is XSS-safe and the mutating API is CSRF-safe: transcript/summary/model text is rendered only via textContent (never innerHTML), responses carry a strict Content-Security-Policy (no inline script from data, default-src self), and POST /api/enrich and /api/chat require Content-Type application/json plus an Origin header equal to the configured site origin
no API response or page path writes model or transcript text through innerHTML; foreign-Origin or non-JSON POSTs get 403

the chat model and the MCP surface get no tools or side effects driven by model output: retrieved transcript text is untrusted context (prompt-injection), the chat model only produces text, and enrich runs only from an explicit operator click or CLI/MCP call with apply
the chat completions request carries no tools/functions field

the Access JWT check fails closed: pocketsync web refuses to start without POCKETSYNC_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and POCKETSYNC_ACCESS_AUD unless run with an explicit --no-access-check (loopback dev only, loud warning); JWKS (https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/certs) is fetched lazily, cached, refreshed on unknown kid, and an unreachable JWKS yields 503 not allow
missing/forged/expired/wrong-aud tokens get 403; partial Access config refuses to start; unreachable JWKS gives 503

the chat request disables reasoning output for thinking models (chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false and strips any leftover think block), caps the retrieved context (top 8 chunks, ~6000 chars) and the answer length, and returns 503 with the retrieved citations still listed when the chat lane is down
no think block reaches the browser; chat-lane failure still returns the citations

when query embedding fails (embed lane down) search degrades to a case-insensitive keyword match over title, summary and chunk text with recording-level filters, and says so in the result (mode: keyword)
with embed down, search returns keyword matches labelled mode=keyword instead of an error
web access logging records method, path without query string, status and duration only — never question text, request bodies or answers
the journal never contains question or answer text

tasks.summary: settings: chat_model, web_port, access_team_domain, access_aud, site_origin
acceptance_criteria: pocketsync/config.py: Settings gains chat_model (default unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, env POCKETSYNC_CHAT_MODEL), web_port (int, default 8788), access_team_domain, access_aud, site_origin (default https://pocketchat.culture.dev); none are in SECRET_SETTINGS
tests/test_config.py covers defaults, env override and that SECRET_SETTINGS is unchanged
tasks.instruction: only touch pocketsync/config.py and tests/test_config.py; follow the _SETTING_NAMES/_INT_FIELDS pattern

tasks.summary: gateway: query embeddings and a chat-completions call
acceptance_criteria: GatewayClient.embed(texts, prompt_name='Document') accepts prompt_name='Query'; existing callers unchanged

GatewayClient.chat(messages, model, max_tokens) POSTs /chat/completions with chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false, no tools/functions field, strips any think block from the answer, raises EnrichmentUnavailable on 404/429/5xx/unreachable
GatewayClient takes chat_model (default constant) so tests assert the request model
tasks.instruction: only pocketsync/enrich/gateway.py and tests/test_gateway*.py (new test file ok); reuse _post; tests capture request bodies with the existing fake transport style

tasks.summary: vindex: sensitive and has_action_items filter fields, in-place index update
acceptance_criteria: FILTER_PATHS adds enrichment.filters.sensitive and enrichment.filters.has_action_items on both indexes

ensure_index calls update_search_index for a present index whose definition differs (fields), creates missing ones, and check() stays dims/model-only; tests/test_vindex.py covers create, update and no-op
tasks.instruction: only pocketsync/vindex.py and tests/test_vindex.py; keep PATH constants exported for the recall core

tasks.summary: sink: requeue with generation, generation-aware CAS, persisted deferral, partial writes
acceptance_criteria: MongoSink.requeue(ids, mode) sets status pending, attempts 0, mode (full|classify|embed), increments enrichment.generation, unsets error/next_attempt_at/deferred_reason, skips deleted docs, returns the count
pending_enrichment returns generation; set_enrichment/set_enrichment_error take expected_generation and match it (absent generation matches docs without one)
set_deferred(rid, hash, generation, reason, next_attempt_at) persists enrichment.deferred_reason and next_attempt_at on a pending doc; set_enrichment clears them
ENRICHMENT_FIELDS whitelist grows (mode, generation, deferred_reason); put_recording content change still resets everything
tasks.instruction: only pocketsync/sinks/mongo.py and tests/test_sink_mongo.py; mongomock-based tests

tasks.summary: web access: cite culture-rules' stdlib Cloudflare Access JWT verifier
acceptance_criteria: pocketsync/web/access.py is cited from culture-rules culture_rules/auth/access.py (provenance header), config all-or-nothing from POCKETSYNC_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN/POCKETSYNC_ACCESS_AUD, reason codes malformed/unknown_kid/bad_signature/bad_issuer/bad_audience/expired/not_yet_valid

tests/test_web_access.py signs tokens with a locally generated RSA key (stdlib or test-only helper) and a fake JWKS fetcher; covers valid, forged, expired, wrong aud, unknown kid refetch window, JWKS unreachable -> unavailable
tasks.instruction: create pocketsync/web/__init__.py (empty docstring only) and pocketsync/web/access.py; no network in tests; adapt names to pocketsync; key generation for tests may use a fixed small test keypair committed as synthetic test data

tasks.summary: worker: enrichment modes, generation CAS, persisted deferrals, reclassified event, status deferral report
acceptance_criteria: EnrichmentWorker honours enrichment.mode: classify reuses stored chunk/summary text and writes only labels/filters/taxonomy_version (0 embed calls); embed keeps labels/filters (0 classify calls); full unchanged
a requeue (generation bump) during processing is not overwritten: the finishing run's CAS misses and the doc stays pending
EnrichmentUnavailable persists deferred_reason + next_attempt_at via set_deferred and the worker skips docs not yet due after restart
a run whose labels differ from the previous labels with unchanged content_hash appends one pocketsync.recording.reclassified event (outbox key includes a labels digest); unchanged labels append none
status --json adds enrichment_deferred {count, next_attempt_at, reasons}; text mode prints it; existing status/reembed/sync/events tests pass unedited
tasks.instruction: files: pocketsync/enrich/worker.py, pocketsync/events.py, pocketsync/cli/_commands/status.py and their tests; pending_enrichment due-filter for pending docs with next_attempt_at belongs here only if t4 did not add it — coordinate by reading t4's merged sink

tasks.summary: recall core: search and read operations
acceptance_criteria: pocketsync/recall/search.py: search(store, gateway, query, labels, since, until, has_action_items, exclude_sensitive, limit, search_fn) embeds with prompt_name Query, builds chunk ( parentFilter) and summary (filter) pipelines, merges by recording, excludes deleted_in_pocket and merged_into, returns ids/title/recording_at/score/best chunks with start/end (local cosine over stored chunk vectors)
exclude_sensitive drops docs with enrichment.filters.sensitive >= threshold, keeps absent; default returns everything
embed failure falls back to keyword (case-insensitive regex over title, summary, chunk text) with mode=keyword
pocketsync/recall/read.py: get_recording, get_transcript(id, start, end), list_recordings(since, until, label, limit), list_action_items(open_only) — no vectors in outputs
unit tests inject search_fn; no $vectorSearch through mongomock; tests/integration/test_atlas_local.py gains an opt-in search case
tasks.instruction: new package pocketsync/recall/ (search.py, read.py, __init__.py) + tests/test_recall_*.py; pure stdlib; import PATH constants from vindex

acceptance_criteria: pocketsync/recall/enrich.py: plan_enrich(store, all, since, until, ids, label, status, only) returns selected ids, count and estimated gateway calls without writing; apply calls MongoSink.requeue(ids, mode)
requires at least one selector (--all or another), refuses unknown status/only values, skips deleted docs; tests over mongomock cover each selector and dry-run snapshot equality
tasks.instruction: only pocketsync/recall/enrich.py and tests/test_recall_enrich.py; if t7 has not created pocketsync/recall/__init__.py yet create it with only a docstring (merge resolves trivially)

CLI registers every registry verb data-driven with --json and, for mutating verbs, --apply default off; enrich prints ids/count/estimate in dry-run; reembed unchanged (its tests pass unedited)
mcp and web command modules exist, lazily import pocketsync.mcp.server / pocketsync.web.server and raise CliError exit 2 with an install/implementation hint when absent
explain catalog, learn text+JSON, overview._VERBS, _grant.RUNTIME_VERBS and tests/test_cli_surface.py NEW_VERBS list every new verb; teken cli doctor . --strict passes
Runtime gains a chat accessor (GatewayClient with settings.chat_model) overridden in tests/cli_fakes.py; tests/test_surface_parity.py asserts registry == CLI commands (MCP half added by t10)

acceptance_criteria: pyproject gains extra mcp = [mcp>=1.2,<2] and the dev group adds it; pocketsync/mcp/{__init__,__main__,server,tools}.py with lazy _sdk() and ServerExtraMissing; tools.py has no third-party imports

tasks.summary: pocketsync web: loopback server, Access-gated JSON API, RAG chat with citations, single page
acceptance_criteria: pocketsync/web/server.py: stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, loopback-only (ValueError otherwise), port from settings.web_port; GET / serves pocketsync/web/static/index.html; JSON API /api/search, /api/chat, /api/recordings, /api/recordings/{id}, /api/recordings/{id}/transcript, /api/actions, /api/enrich calling registry verbs

every request is verified with the Access verifier (403 on failure, 503 when JWKS unavailable); refuses to start with partial or missing Access config unless --no-access-check; POSTs need application/json and Origin == settings.site_origin

pocketsync/web/chat.py: retrieves top chunks (cap 8 / ~6000 chars), system prompt marks context as quoted data, calls GatewayClient.chat with no tools, returns answer + citations (id, title, start, end) only from retrieved hits; zero hits -> found-nothing answer; chat-lane failure -> 503 with citations
index.html uses textContent only (no innerHTML), CSP default-src 'self', citation click opens transcript at timestamp, Re-enrich button does dry-run then apply
access log lines: method, path without query, status, duration only; tests/test_web*.py cover all of the above on an ephemeral port with fakes
